Welcome-para1: Intranet Mapping System (IMS) is a 2D and 3D web-based Geographical Information System (GIS) which integrates road data and road related information from various systems within HyD and other B/Ds designed for HyD's internal use. It provides convenient on-line tools for HyD's users for searching and viewing road inventory data and road related information and performing basic GIS analysis.
